title: Rookie Soldier Gets Sent To Alien War, Gains Infinite Respawn Loop #fantasy#timeloop#respawnpower
description:
A rookie talks back to his superior and is shipped straight to front lines.
Earth fights vicious Mimic aliens that wrecked millions of troops in 5 years.
